title: Fast stability tests for Hermitian matrix polynomials
summary: Assessing the asymptotic stability of linear self-adjoint homogeneous systems of differential-algebraic equations requires testing the Hurwitz stability of the associated Hermitian matrix polynomial $P(λ)$. Tests for known necessary and sufficient conditions rely on linearizations and eigensolvers, solving matrix equations and testing matrix inequalities, or generalized Bézoutians, and scale with either $O(d^2 n^3)$ or $O(d^3n^3)$ complexity, where $d$ and $n$ are the degree and size of $P(λ)$, respectively.
